candidates.text: The external projection provisions of UN R26 shall not apply to those parts of the rear lamp's external surface (outer lens, exposed housing rim/bezel, exposed seal) which, with the vehicle in the laden condition and all doors, windows and access lids etc. in the closed position, are at a height of more than 2 metres.

candidates.text: The external surface of the installed rear lamp (outer lens, exposed housing rim/bezel, exposed seal) shall not exhibit, directed outwards, any pointed or sharp parts or any projections of such shape, dimensions, direction or hardness as to be likely to increase the risk or seriousness of bodily injury to a person hit by the external surface or brushing against it in the event of a collision.

candidates.text: The external surface of the installed rear lamp shall not exhibit, directed outwards, any part likely to catch on pedestrians, cyclists or motor cyclists.

candidates.text: No protruding part of the rear lamp's external surface (lens and exposed housing edges) shall have a radius of curvature less than 2.5 mm; this does not apply to parts of the external surface which protrude less than 5 mm, but the outward facing angles of such parts shall be blunted, save where such parts protrude less than 1.5 mm.

raw.text: No protruding part of the rear lamp's external surface (lens and exposed housing edges) shall have a radius of curvature less than 2.5 mm; this does not apply to parts of the external surface which protrude less than 5 mm, but the outward facing angles of such parts shall be blunted, save where such parts protrude less than 1.5 mm.

candidates.text: If a protruding part of the rear lamp's external surface (e.g. an exposed TPE/silicone seal) is made of a material of hardness not exceeding 60 Shore A, it may have a radius of curvature less than 2.5 mm.

candidates.text: The Shore A hardness of a protruding part of the rear lamp's external surface claimed under the hardness provision shall be measured with the component as installed on the vehicle; where it is impossible to carry out a hardness measurement by the Shore A procedure, comparable measurements shall be used for evaluation.

candidates.text: The rear lamp as fitted to vehicles approved under UN R26 shall be so manufactured as to conform to the approved type by meeting the requirements set forth in paragraphs 5. and 6. of UN R26.

candidates.text: If the rear lamp protrudes beyond the nominal line of the panel and is mounted on a convex surface, the dimension of its projection may be determined either directly or by reference to a drawing of an appropriate section of the lamp in its installed condition.

raw.text: If the rear lamp protrudes beyond the nominal line of the panel and is mounted on a convex surface, the dimension of its projection may be determined either directly or by reference to a drawing of an appropriate section of the lamp in its installed condition.

candidates.text: If the rear lamp protrudes beyond the nominal line of the panel, is mounted on a surface other than convex, and the dimension of its projection cannot be determined by simple measurement, the dimension of the projection shall be determined by the maximum variation of the distance of the centre of a 100 mm diameter sphere from the nominal line of the panel when the sphere is moved over the lamp while in constant contact with it.
